chunks: Ali ibn Abdullah al-Warraq told us, he said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah told us, he said: Al-Abbas ibn Sa'id al-Azraq (who was from the 'Ammah) told us, he said: Abdul-Rahman ibn Salih told us, he said: Shareek ibn Abdullah, from Alaa' ibn Abd al-Karim, he said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:
And Allah calls to the Home of Peace
He said: Indeed, the Peace is Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, and His Home that He created for His allies is Paradise.

key_terms.دَارِ السَّلَامِ: The Home of Peace (referring to Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Dar al-Salam' in Surah Yunus according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) offers a profound ontological interpretation of Surah Yunus 10:25, identifying 'Al-Salam' not merely as an attribute but as a direct reference to the Divine Essence itself. He further clarifies that 'Dar al-Salam' signifies Paradise, specifically prepared as the eternal abode for the *Awliya* (friends/allies of God). This exegesis highlights the Shia emphasis on the intimate connection between the Divine Name and the spiritual destiny of the faithful.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Ali bin Abdullah al-Warraq, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, that he said: We were told by Abbas bin Sa’eed al-Azraq – and he was from the ‘Aamma [1] – that he said: We were told by Abdul-Rahman bin Saleh, that he said: We were told by Shareek bin Abdullah, from ‘Alaa’ bin Abdil-Karim, that he said: I heard Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, say with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He:
«And Allah calls for the Home of Peace» [10:25]
to which he said: Indeed, the Peace is Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, and His Home that He created for His allies is Paradise.
